description: He wears an opaque deep purple long noble coat with wide gold woven borders decorated in geometric medallions along the opening, cuffs and hem. An ivory long-sleeved tunic shows beneath, with patterned gold trim at the collar and cuffs. A matching purple drape crosses the upper chest from one shoulder, held by a round ornate gold clasp. A narrow decorated belt and gold buckle sit at the waist, with woven tails hanging below. Dark trousers and brown leather boots are fully visible. Cloth has a softly textured sheen; exact fiber is uncertain.
